statement: A question that survives slugification as the empty string MUST become the literal slug `decision`. Slugification strips every character outside [a-z0-9], so a question made only of punctuation reduces to nothing, and a record still needs a bounded, non-empty name.
note: Verified by execution: record_filename() at v0.8.3 with a punctuation-only question yields `2026-07-25-decision.md`.
